description: This file contains implementations of Avro-related functions for PySpark, including from_avro and to_avro, along with a test function for testing these functionalities.

methods.name: from_avro
methods.description: Converts binary data from Avro format to a Spark Column based on a JSON schema.

methods.name: to_avro
methods.description: Converts a Spark Column to Avro format based on a JSON schema.

methods.name: _test
methods.description: Runs tests for the Avro functions, including setting up environment and Spark session.
